Commands use the safe mode and flags every root manager honors.
The phone boot-loops after a module update
The overlay or the privapp allowlist stopped the system server from starting. Every supported root solution can boot with its modules disabled, and no user data is touched.
Safe mode or the manager turned the module off. The overlay is not mounted, so the privileged grants are absent and calls fail without a clear error.
Root is gone after an update
An over-the-air update flashed a stock boot image, so su is gone. The pairing lives in device-protected storage and survives the update.
The module is enabled, but this APK does not run from /system/priv-app, or a permission is missing from its allowlist. Capture and in-call control then fail without a clear error.
The link is down, the daemon is not running, or the path is blocked. Android 17 reports a missing local-network grant as a timeout, so the permission comes before any network theory.
The daemon answered but refused the credentials: the token expired, the certificate changed, or the protocol versions differ.
The link is up but audio is silent
On Android 17 the audio hardening and the foreground-service type decide whether the bridge may touch audio outside a call. A silent link looks exactly like a connected one.
The call dropped at the phone
The call ended on the phone side. The link counters and the daemon\'s error say whether the link or the audio path went first.
